analysis.title: Emerging Markets Morning Pulse, 12 November 2026
key_insights: EM credit was subdued on 11 Nov because of the US Veterans' Day holiday and no cash Treasury trading. LATAM, Brazil and MENA saw minimal activity.
BEEFBZ stayed under pressure ahead of its 3Q26 earnings release after the close. BRASKEM stayed in focus after reports that creditors presented two restructuring proposals.

Primary pipeline: Boubyan Bank announced an AT1 sukuk (NC5.5) at IPT 7.875% with desk fair value near 7.50%. Al Rayan Bank mandated an inaugural 5-year sukuk at T+150bp initial guidance, which the desk expects to tighten to around +125bp.
CEE credit held up despite pressure on EUR rates. The new NOVALJ euro perpetual drew two-way flow and closed 0.20 to 0.40 points above reoffer.

US Treasuries edged higher in Asian hours on safe-haven demand tied to Nvidia leadership concerns. The 10-year yield fell 1bp to 4.98% and the 30-year fell as much as 3bp to 5.32%. Futures had weakened after hotter-than-expected US inflation data and hawkish Fed commentary.
Markets fully price a 25bp Fed hike in December, with a small probability of a 50bp hike.

Nvidia fell as much as 10% after hours on uncertainty around CEO Jensen Huang. S&P 500 futures fell 0.4% and Nasdaq 100 futures fell 0.9% after the indices rose 1.3% and 2.3% on Wednesday. CoreWeave rose 25%.

The Bloomberg Dollar Spot Index rose 0.4% on Wednesday to an 18-month high. USD/JPY was near the 160 level at 159.70. Indonesia's rupiah hit a record low amid dollar strength and a possible MSCI exclusion of Indonesian equities.
WTI fell 1.5% to $85.24 and Brent traded near $91, as rising Middle Eastern production and subdued US-Iran hostilities weighed on prices.
NATURA reports after the market on 12 Nov. The desk says it could trigger trading in the name and help show the state of the Brazilian consumer.

market_movers.rationale: Shares fell as much as 10% after hours on uncertainty around CEO Jensen Huang, which weighed on tech stocks and AI sentiment.
CoreWeave surged 25%, adding to AI optimism.

earnings_insights: BEEFBZ (Brazilian beef producer): 3Q26 earnings due after the close on 11/12 (upcoming, no estimate cited). Bonds under pressure ahead of the release.
NATURA: results due after market on 11/12 (upcoming, no estimate cited). The desk says they could drive trading and indicate Brazilian consumer health.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Supported hawkish Fed expectations and a firmer dollar.
